test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank meaningfully.

His ____________ is a brilliant student.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The correctly spelled word is 'son'.**

__
 
• **The word 'son' refers to a male offspring.**
 
• It is the appropriate word to complete the sentence meaningfully: "His **son** is a brilliant student."

Therefore, the correct answer is **'son'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Explanation of the other options:**

 
• **Option 1 (sune):** This is an incorrect spelling and does not have any meaningful usage in this context.
 
• **Option 2 (sun):** Refers to the star at the center of the solar system and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (sone):** This spelling does not relate to the intended context of the sentence.
